cards.subject: The Stonemasons Guild
lines: Bazil Thredd was one of the masons who rebuilt Stormwind after the First War, went unpaid, and rioted. He was caught in the riots that killed Queen Tiffin.
This is a prison in the basement of a city its prisoners built.

cards.subject: Warden Thelwater
lines: He is not briefing you. He is panicking. "How could this happen?" "All of a sudden they were everywhere." "They must have had someone helping them."
And then: "If the Captain finds out, it'll be the end of me."
The riot was kept secret. You are not a hero here, you are a cleanup crew.

cards.subject: The smallest dungeon in the game
cards.tag: And it still takes an hour
lines: Possibly the smallest instance there is, and because of the number of bodies in close quarters it can run as long as a full-sized one.
It is smaller than the Deadmines with about the same number of named enemies.

cards.subject: Targorr the Dread
lines: He wears a proto-orc model left over from the game's alpha — a shape that shipped almost nowhere else.
He was supreme executioner for the Blackrock clan under Gath'Ilzogg.
Taken alive, and never executed.

cards.subject: Kam Deepfury
cards.tag: Nothing to do with any of this
lines: The one prisoner who is not Defias. A Dark Iron dwarf who blew the bridge on the Thandol Span and killed a dwarf's kin doing it.
Motley Garmason at Dun Modr, up in the Wetlands, wants his head.
A quest from a swamp twenty levels north, cashed in a cellar under Stormwind.

cards.subject: Hamhock
lines: A two-headed ogre mage in a human city prison. There is no canon reason for him to be here.
He had no significant loot and was attached to no quest.
He is simply in there, and always has been.

cards.subject: Dextren Ward
lines: He robbed graves at Raven Hill in Duskwood and sold the bodies on to Morbent Fel. Councilman Millstipe wanted him taken.
The name is Lovecraft — The Case of Charles Dexter Ward, about a man digging up the dead to raise them.
He is a fear-caster, which in corridors this tight is the whole fight.

cards.subject: Bruegal Ironknuckle
lines: The Stockade has exceptionally poor loot from every boss, with one exception, and he is a rare spawn.
Iron Knuckles, Jimmied Handcuffs, Prison Shank. Those and Kam's walking stick are the only rare items in the place.
He may simply not be in there.

cards.subject: They think they have won
lines: "Tell the warden this prison is ours now!" And to arrivals: "More of the warden's errand boys!"
Bruegal, if he is up: "Death to the Warden's men!" "Welcome to the Stockade!"
They have won, until you arrive.

cards.subject: The curious visitor
cards.tag: Killing Thredd is step three of twelve
lines: For months before the riot a hooded man calling himself Maelik came to visit Thredd's cell. The warden noticed and wrote down a description.
That scrap of paper opens a twelve-quest chain that ends with an audience with the King.
Baros Alexston reads it and cannot place him: "But it could be anybody!"
